csv_scope_of_work: Dane County is soliciting applications from organizations interested in the Homebuilding project area, which is the development of affordable new housing for low-and-moderate income residents of the Dane County Urban County Consortium. Homebuilding is defined as new construction of single-family homes, paired with the Mortgage Reduction Assistance loan for the low- to moderate-income household purchasing the home. Funding is expected to be available under the HUD-funded Home Investment Partnership (HOME) funds. This change in funding source and its implications will be discussed with prospective Subrecipient(s). Please refer to the attached documents for more details.

title: Developer Services for CDBG Homebuilding
short_description: Developer sought for affordable single-family home construction in Dane County.
project_scope: Development of affordable new housing within the Dane County Urban County Consortium. The project area is defined as new construction of single-family homes, paired with Mortgage Reduction Assistance loans for low- to moderate-income households purchasing the homes. No quantities, floor areas, or technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Developer services / design-build services for affordable homebuilding funded through HUD HOME funds; one or more contracts may be awarded.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer/design-build solicitation for affordable single-family housing.
- No indication of complex structural engineering, long spans, bridges, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- Small-scale residential buildings are generally not a strategic fit for sbp.
- Limited explicit planning scope relevant to specialist structural design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Only funding context is given: HUD HOME funds for affordable single-family home construction with mortgage reduction assistance. No number of homes, unit sizes, or total program value is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is for developer/design-build services and does not state any engineering fee, planning fee, or percentage basis.
references_qualifications: Organizations interested in the homebuilding project area are invited to apply. The source does not specify detailed reference requirements, minimum number of comparable projects, or formal qualification thresholds.
